name: developer-friendliness
description: Everything an assistant produces that outlives the conversation — what gets filed, written down, reported, read back, and left behind at a session boundary — kept so the developer never has to hold what could have been parked and never pays full price to get it back. A three-question filter, a durability ladder whose top rung is deleting the note by making the situation impossible, a retrieval ladder for reading a record without paying for all of it, and a budget that makes a tracker nobody triages as much of a failure as writing nothing. Installed into ~/.claude/rules by build-skills.mjs install, so it is loaded in every session rather than waiting to be invoked
